name: sdlc
description: Whoever made the change, someone else attacks it, and a machine decides when it is done. Four hooks lock committed tests, run your check before the agent can stop, cap AGENTS.md and gate first-seen dependencies. Three fresh agents attack designs and tests, review the diff and verify it against the running app. Two short skills: build, where you author to learn or the agent authors to delegate, and onboard, which sets up the check, mutation testing, property-based tests and a sandbox.
